visual.detailed_description: Photograph of a printed film, with a dark surround and slight glare, showing a sagittal MRI section of the lower spine. A column of vertebral bodies separated by intervertebral discs runs down the picture, with a thin bright band behind them along the spinal canal and soft tissue and the skin edge behind that. The lowest vertebral levels and sacrum curve toward the bottom of the film. Along the right edge there is a short vertical scale with tick marks. Scanner parameter text is partly legible along the left and lower-left edges. Printed header text overlays the image (a partly pixelated label block, a birth-date line, an examination date and time line and a magnification label); values are not transcribed here. No arrows, panel letters or annotations are drawn on the image.
